import json, os

                        ret = d[k]

                if ve is not None or ret is not None:
                    print(f'step={step}, ve_ratio={ve}, eval_return={ret}')
                if ve is not None:
                    last_ve = ve; last_ve_step = step
                if ret is not None:
                    last_ret = ret; last_ret_step = step
            last = json.loads(lines[-1])
            print(f'CURRENT_STEP={last.get(\"step\",\"?\")}')
            print(f'VE_RATIO_FINAL={last_ve}@{last_ve_step}')
            print(f'EVAL_FINAL={last_ret}@{last_ret_step}')
            break
"
